primaryGoal: Track and optimize sales opportunity pipeline management to drive revenue growth and improve sales team performance across the EMEA region by identifying pipeline hygiene issues, optimizing SE resource allocation, improving conversion rates, and accelerating deal velocity.
assumptions: Opportunity Stage values follow a sequential progression from S1 (discovery) through S7 (closed won), with M0/M1 representing earlier qualification stages.
The [Opportunity Close Date] field accurately reflects expected or actual close dates for opportunities.
Null values in [Opportunity SE Name] indicate genuinely unassigned opportunities requiring attention.
EMEA team designations in [Opportunity Owner Team] are mutually exclusive and comprehensive for the region.
The [Opportunity S2 To S7 Conversion] metric is pre-calculated and represents a reliable conversion rate.
[Activity Hours] logged by SEs accurately reflect their workload and engagement levels.
Opportunities with [Opportunity ACV] > 0 represent legitimate revenue opportunities worthy of analysis.
The user context indicates 'past-due close dates' and 'stuck in stages' are critical pipeline health indicators, though specific date thresholds may need to be defined.

phases.phaseDescription: Establish baseline understanding of overall EMEA pipeline health by measuring total opportunity volume, revenue potential, and closed revenue across the region to identify macro-level performance trends.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1.1: EMEA Regional Opportunity Volume
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve total count of opportunities for all EMEA teams to understand overall pipeline volume.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity Owner Team], [Opportunity Count]. Filters: [Opportunity Owner Team] in ('emea', 'emea benelux', 'emea commercial', 'emea commercial 1', 'emea commercial 2', 'emea dach', 'emea emerging enterprise', 'emea partner', 'emea uki', 'emea western europe'). Aggregation: Count of opportunities.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Owner Team] is in ('emea', 'emea benelux', 'emea commercial', 'emea commercial 1', 'emea commercial 2', 'emea dach', 'emea emerging enterprise', 'emea partner', 'emea uki', 'emea western europe'). Include columns [Opportunity Owner Team] and [Opportunity Name] for counting.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1.2: Total EMEA Pipeline ACV
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve total Annual Contract Value across all EMEA opportunities to measure revenue potential.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity ACV]. Filters: [Opportunity Owner Team] in ('emea', 'emea benelux', 'emea commercial', 'emea commercial 1', 'emea commercial 2', 'emea dach', 'emea emerging enterprise', 'emea partner', 'emea uki', 'emea western europe'). Aggregation: Sum of [Opportunity ACV].
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Owner Team] is in ('emea', 'emea benelux', 'emea commercial', 'emea commercial 1', 'emea commercial 2', 'emea dach', 'emea emerging enterprise', 'emea partner', 'emea uki', 'emea western europe'). Include columns [Opportunity ACV] and [Opportunity Name].

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1.3: Closed Won Revenue (Booked ACV)
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve actual booked revenue from closed won opportunities to measure realized performance.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity Booked ACV], [Opportunity Stage]. Filters: [Opportunity Stage] = 's7 closed won'. Aggregation: Sum of [Opportunity Booked ACV].
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Stage] is 's7 closed won'. Include columns [Opportunity Booked ACV] and [Opportunity Name].

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1.1.1: Calculate Total EMEA Opportunity Count
analysisSteps.question: What is the total volume of opportunities currently in the EMEA pipeline?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the fetched EMEA opportunity data, calculate the total count of opportunities across all EMEA teams. Provide this as the baseline pipeline volume metric and state: 'Total EMEA pipeline contains [X] opportunities across all regional teams.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Executive Pipeline Health Overview

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1.1.2: Identify Top 3 EMEA Teams by Volume

analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Group the fetched data by [Opportunity Owner Team] and count opportunities for each team. Identify and report the top 3 teams with the highest opportunity counts. Format as: 'Top 3 EMEA teams by volume: 1) [Team A] with [X] opportunities, 2) [Team B] with [Y] opportunities, 3) [Team C] with [Z] opportunities. This indicates where pipeline activity is concentrated.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Executive Pipeline Health Overview

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1.2.1: Calculate Total Pipeline ACV
analysisSteps.question: What is the total Annual Contract Value of the EMEA pipeline?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the fetched data, calculate the sum of [Opportunity ACV] across all EMEA opportunities. Report as: 'Total EMEA pipeline ACV is $[X], representing the total annual revenue potential if all opportunities close successfully.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Executive Pipeline Health Overview

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 6.4: Opportunities with Completed Trials that Closed Won

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 6.1.1: Count Completed PoV Deliverables
analysisSteps.question: How many Proof of Value engagements have been completed?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Calculate the sum of [Vivun Deliverables Count] for finished PoV deliverables. Report as: '[X] Proof of Value engagements have been completed. PoVs represent significant pre-sales investment and are critical for validating technical fit and driving deal progression.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pre-Sales Effectiveness - PoV and Trial Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 6.2.1: Count Completed Trial Deliverables
analysisSteps.question: How many trial engagements have been completed?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Calculate the sum of [Vivun Deliverables Count] for finished trial deliverables. Report as: '[X] trial engagements have been completed. Trials provide hands-on product experience and are an important pre-sales tool.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pre-Sales Effectiveness - PoV and Trial Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 6.3.1: Count PoV Opportunities that Closed Won
analysisSteps.question: How many opportunities with completed PoVs resulted in closed won deals?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Count opportunities that had finished PoVs and closed won. Report as: '[X] opportunities with completed PoVs resulted in closed won deals. To calculate PoV win rate, divide this by the total completed PoVs from Analysis 6.1.1: Win rate = [X won] / [Y total PoVs] = [Z]%. This measures the effectiveness of PoV engagements in driving deal success.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pre-Sales Effectiveness - PoV and Trial Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 6.3.2: Calculate Revenue from PoV-Supported Wins
analysisSteps.question: What is the total booked ACV from opportunities that completed PoVs and closed won?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Sum [Opportunity Booked ACV] for PoV-supported closed won opportunities. Report as: '$[X] in booked ACV came from opportunities that completed PoV engagements. This represents the revenue impact of technical pre-sales investment and justifies PoV resource allocation.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pre-Sales Effectiveness - PoV and Trial Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 6.4.1: Count Trial Opportunities that Closed Won
analysisSteps.question: How many opportunities with completed trials resulted in closed won deals?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Count opportunities that had finished trials and closed won. Report as: '[X] opportunities with completed trials resulted in closed won deals. Trial conversion rate = [X won] / [Y total trials from Analysis 6.2.1] = [Z]%. This measures trial effectiveness in converting prospects to customers.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pre-Sales Effectiveness - PoV and Trial Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 6.4.2: Calculate Revenue from Trial-Supported Wins
analysisSteps.question: What is the total booked ACV from opportunities that completed trials and closed won?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Sum [Opportunity Booked ACV] for trial-supported closed won opportunities. Report as: '$[X] in booked ACV came from opportunities that completed trial engagements. Compare this to PoV-supported revenue (Analysis 6.3.2) to understand which pre-sales motion generates more revenue.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pre-Sales Effectiveness - PoV and Trial Analysis

phases.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve opportunity counts across all pipeline stages to understand stage distribution.

fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve all open opportunities with positive ACV to focus on revenue-generating deals.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity ACV], [Opportunity Name]. Filters: [Opportunity Stage] not in ('s7 closed won', 's7 closed lost'), [Opportunity ACV] > 0.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Stage] is not 's7 closed won' and not 's7 closed lost' and [Opportunity ACV] is greater than 0. Include columns [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], and [Opportunity ACV].
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Type] is 'new customer' and [Opportunity Stage] is in ('m0', 'm1', 's1 discovery'). Include columns [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], and [Opportunity ACV].
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 8.4: Renewal Opportunities by Stage
fetchSteps.objective: Analyze renewal opportunity distribution across stages to assess retention pipeline health.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity Type], [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], [Opportunity ACV]. Filters: [Opportunity Type] contains 'renewal'.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Type] contains the word 'renewal'. Include columns [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], and [Opportunity ACV].
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 8.5: Expansion Opportunities by Stage
fetchSteps.objective: Analyze expansion opportunity distribution to assess upsell/cross-sell pipeline health.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity Type], [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], [Opportunity ACV]. Filters: [Opportunity Type] contains 'expansion'.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Type] contains the word 'expansion'. Include columns [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], and [Opportunity ACV].
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 8.6: High-Value Opportunities (ACV > $100K) by Stage
fetchSteps.objective: Identify distribution of high-value opportunities to focus executive attention.

fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity ACV] is greater than 100000 and [Opportunity Stage] is not 's7 closed won' and not 's7 closed lost'. Include columns [Opportunity Stage], [Opportunity Name], [Opportunity ACV], and [Opportunity Owner Team].

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.1.1: Count Opportunities by Pipeline Stage
analysisSteps.question: How are opportunities distributed across pipeline stages?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Group by [Opportunity Stage] and count opportunities in each stage. Report as: 'Opportunity distribution by stage: M0: [X], M1: [Y], S1: [Z], S2: [A], S3: [B], S4: [C], S5: [D], S6: [E], S7 Closed Won: [F], S7 Closed Lost: [G]. Identify stages with unusual concentrations (bottlenecks) or unexpectedly low counts (leakage points). Healthy pipelines show progressive narrowing from early to late stages.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.2.1: Count Open Opportunities with Positive ACV
analysisSteps.question: How many open opportunities have positive ACV values?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Count all open opportunities with positive ACV. Report as: '[X] open opportunities have positive ACV values, representing active revenue-generating deals in the pipeline that require ongoing management.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.2.2: Calculate Total ACV of Open Pipeline
analysisSteps.question: What is the total ACV value of the open pipeline?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Sum [Opportunity ACV] for all open opportunities. Report as: 'Total open pipeline ACV is $[X], representing the active revenue potential requiring sales team focus. Compare this to closed won ACV (from Phase 1, Step 1.3.1) to understand pipeline-to-revenue ratio.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.3.1: Count Early-Stage New Customer Opportunities
analysisSteps.question: How many new customer opportunities are in early pipeline stages?

Report as: 'Early-stage new customer pipeline: M0: [X] opportunities, M1: [Y] opportunities, S1 Discovery: [Z] opportunities. Total: [SUM] early-stage new customer opportunities. This indicates the health of new logo acquisition pipeline.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.4.1: Count Renewal Opportunities by Stage

analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Group by [Opportunity Stage] and count renewal opportunities. Report as: 'Renewal opportunity distribution: [Stage A]: [X], [Stage B]: [Y], ... S7 Closed Won: [Z]. Renewal opportunities should progress quickly through stages. Any renewals stuck in early stages (M0, M1, S1) indicate customer health issues requiring immediate attention.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.4.2: Calculate Total Renewal ACV in Pipeline
analysisSteps.question: What is the total ACV value of renewal opportunities in the pipeline?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Sum [Opportunity ACV] for all renewal opportunities. Report as: '$[X] in renewal ACV is in the pipeline, representing revenue at risk if renewals do not close successfully. This is existing customer revenue that must be protected.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.5.1: Count Expansion Opportunities by Stage
analysisSteps.question: How are expansion opportunities distributed across pipeline stages?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Group by [Opportunity Stage] and count expansion opportunities. Report as: 'Expansion opportunity distribution: [Stage A]: [X], [Stage B]: [Y], ... S7 Closed Won: [Z]. Healthy expansion pipelines indicate strong customer success and land-and-expand strategy execution.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.5.2: Calculate Total Expansion ACV in Pipeline
analysisSteps.question: What is the total ACV value of expansion opportunities?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Sum [Opportunity ACV] for all expansion opportunities. Report as: '$[X] in expansion ACV is in the pipeline, representing growth potential from existing customers. Compare to new customer and renewal ACV to understand pipeline composition.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8.6.1: Count High-Value Opportunities by Stage

analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Group by [Opportunity Stage] and count opportunities with ACV > $100K. These deals require executive sponsorship and close monitoring.'
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Pipeline Health and Deal Velocity Indicators

analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Group by [Opportunity Owner Team] and count high-value opportunities.
